name: Checkpoint Continuity
description: Makes retries and model failover continue from verified progress instead of restarting the mission.
constraints: Never repeat a guarded mutation whose idempotency key is already complete.
Only verified work may be marked complete in the continuation state.
A provider failure must not erase project files, tests or prior decisions.
guidance: Load the latest mission checkpoint before selecting the next action.
Carry files read, files modified, tests run, completed action keys and the last unresolved error.
On failover, tell the next model what is complete and request only the next delta.
Verify repository state before replaying an action whose completion is uncertain.
completion_checks: Retry and failover preserve the same mission identity and original acceptance criteria.
Completed guarded mutations are not duplicated.
The next provider begins from the latest verified state.
Final evidence includes all work completed across providers.
